The  solution leveraged Vertex AI (Gemini Pro) for natural language understanding, integrated with  LangChain, LlamaIndex, and FAISS to implement a robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)  framework. By combining NLP, machine learning, and vector search with structured data access from BigQuery  and Firestore, the platform enables accurate interpretation of claim requests, contextual document  retrieval from internal policy documents, and real-time decisioning. Built with FastAPI and Python, the  backend supports secure API communication, integrates with enterprise claim databases, and  applies PII redaction, tool calling, and CSAT evaluation for compliance and user experience  optimization. Responsibilities: Developed modular APIs using FastAPI and Python to connect LLM outputs with internal policy  databases (BigQuery, Firestore, PostgreSQL) and document vector search (FAISS).   Implemented LLM orchestration workflows with tool calling, prompt engineering, and LlamaIndex  to deliver accurate, context-aware responses grounded in Aviva’s proprietary documents.   Built secure data pipelines ensuring PII redaction and compliance, integrating GCP IAM, Secret  Manager, and cloud-native security best practices.   Deployed and optimized components via Cloud Functions and monitored system performance  with user feedback loops and CSAT evaluation metrics. Impact: Automated over 65% of routine claims with intelligent document grounding and database validation. Reduced average claim processing time by 75%, increasing user satisfaction and operational efficiency. Established a reusable, secure GenAI foundation for other insurance workflows (fraud detection, underwriting, customer support). This initiative leverages Application  Programming Interfaces (APIs) to facilitate seamless communication between Lloyds Bank and  external financial applications, fostering the development of innovative financial products and  services. Customers can benefit from a broader range of financial insights, budgeting tools, and tailored  offerings, as Open Banking enables the secure sharing of financial information between Lloyds Bank  and trusted third-party applications. The initiative aligns with the broader industry trend towards  increased transparency, competition, and customer empowerment in the financial sector. Lloyds  Bank Open Banking aims to enhance customer experiences, promote financial inclusion, and foster  a more dynamic and competitive financial ecosystem. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in the Open Banking solution. Data Services acts as the master plane of information, which is at the heart of a  digital organization. This brings together operational and analytical dimensions  into a single consistent view of information. Implement secure, observable service-to-service communication using Istio-based Service Mesh for  traffic control and policy enforcement.
